Sure. "Clean up" can mean a lot of things, and I don't want to touch files you haven't asked me to change. I'll start by looking at the repo's current state.

TOOL: git status --short && echo "---" && git log --oneline -n 10 && echo "---" && git ls-files | head -n 200
